And I had absolutely no idea where to start when it came to prompting, so it was definitely a huge mess LMAO... I don't really care that much about writing styles or POV or tense, which is why they're not in here, but I miiight add them in the future if I feel like it. At first, I made this mainly for GLM and maybe Deepseek, but then I started testing it with Gemini and found it works with Claude too so I went fuck it, it's universal now, I guess?

Since this is my first ever preset, I've had a bit of help from Gemini 3.1 Pro for formatting, troubleshooting, etc! The "Sensory Writing", "Anti-Omniscient", and "Content Authorization" (D3NE) prompts are referenced from @selenis's original prompts on Discord—the creator behind SELARU and my main inspiration for all this pain and misery that is prompt engineering.
